description: This Java class 'BufferedRateExecutorStats' manages statistical counters related to rate limiting and execution metrics within the Thingsboard project. It tracks total counts for various events and maintains per-tenant rate limiting counters.

classes.name: BufferedRateExecutorStats
classes.description: Manages statistical counters for rate limiting and execution metrics, including total counts and per-tenant rate limiting.

methods.name: BufferedRateExecutorStats
methods.description: Constructor that initializes various statistical counters using the provided StatsFactory.

methods.name: incrementRateLimitedTenant
methods.description: Increments the rate limiting counter for a specific tenant identified by TenantId.
